title: eat shit & die 154
author: bpatrick
body: The official motto of akimbo remains “Waste your life doing something you love”.

comments.author: Michal
comments.text: Phew! Finished reading the archives. Took me two rather unproductive days at work. I’m in awe of your work and I have to admit I feel a bit envious of your talent. Do update soon, your comics brighten my day, even the bleak ones.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Thanks, Michal! I love the idea of people reading my comics at work. I’m not sure why – maybe because it feels like I’m doing something to make people’s day better, as you said. Thanks, again. I should have an update by this weekend.

comments.author: Juan Santapau
comments.text: Hey! I loved this comic. And: thanks for linking The Secret Knots.

comments.author: christiann
comments.text: This is awesome. I just found your comics and love them!

comments.author: Ash Freeman
comments.text: Just Stumbled this. Perfect sir, just perfect. Art.

comments.author: Matan
comments.text: Just wanted to say, i found this site yesterday – and it is great. great ideas, great comics. i read through practically all the archive i 2 days.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text:
Juan Santapau: Thanks! The Secret Knots is brilliant.
christiann: Thanks!
Ash Freeman: Thank you sir.
Matan: Thanks! That’s a lot of comics – thank you.

comments.author: Deaf singles
comments.text: I agree with Michal. I too am in awe of your work and look forward to more soon. I’ve looked at everything on this site already.
